# Learning / World Models / Imitation / Offline RL — Upstream Research

## danijar/dreamerv3
- License: MIT (verified)
- Role: world-model reinforcement learning.
- NosAi use: offline/sandbox world-model experiments, latent dynamics, prediction research.
- Boundary: never authoritative live truth; advisory only after validation.
- Priority: HIGH research.

## HumanCompatibleAI/imitation
- License: MIT (verified)
- Role: behavior cloning and imitation-learning tooling.
- NosAi use: learn from consenting human demonstration sessions in the private test environment.
- Target: offline training pipeline for Skill Library policies.
- Priority: VERY HIGH.

## takuseno/d3rlpy
- License: MIT (verified)
- Role: offline deep reinforcement learning.
- NosAi use: train from replay/session datasets without uncontrolled live exploration.
- Target: offline learning lab.
- Priority: HIGH.

## kzl/decision-transformer
- License: MIT (verified)
- Role: sequence-modeling formulation of reinforcement learning.
- NosAi use: research baseline for trajectory-conditioned policies/progression tasks.
- Priority: MEDIUM research.

## DLR-RM/stable-baselines3
- License: MIT (verified)
- Role: established RL algorithms and experiment tooling.
- NosAi use: sandbox benchmarks, synthetic environments, policy baselines.
- Priority: HIGH for experiments, not direct production dependency.

## vwxyzjn/cleanrl
- License: MIT (verified)
- Role: compact single-file RL implementations useful for academic understanding and reproducibility.
- NosAi use: reference implementations and experiment baselines.
- Priority: HIGH academic/research.
